description: Golden retrieval set for the Meridian Code Academy synthetic corpus. Each question has a known correct source section. Measures retrieval recall and citation correctness.

questions.question: How long are connection logs kept?
questions.answer: 6 months.

questions.question: How long is video-surveillance footage retained?
questions.answer: 21 days, unless preserved for an open incident.

questions.question: How long are academic transcripts archived?
questions.answer: 40 years after the student leaves.

questions.question: What happens to a failed candidate's admissions results?
questions.answer: Deleted 14 days after the candidate fails.

questions.question: How long is an API token valid?
questions.answer: 90 minutes, after which it must be regenerated.

questions.question: How often is the API secret rotated?
questions.answer: Every 14 days.

questions.question: What is the API rate limit?
questions.answer: 1,200 requests per hour per token.

questions.question: How much does it cost to replace a lost badge?
questions.answer: EUR 8 for the first replacement, EUR 15 for each subsequent one.

questions.question: How long can a locker be used?
questions.answer: At most 72 hours.

questions.question: How long can a visitor stay on campus?
questions.answer: No more than 2 hours.

questions.question: What is the penalty for keeping a soda at a cluster workstation?
questions.answer: A Tier 1 offense: minimum 3 hours of community service.

questions.question: How often are toilet breaks offered during an exam?
questions.answer: Every 45 minutes.

questions.question: How long do exams last?
questions.answer: Between 2 and 6 hours, depending on the exam.

questions.question: When does alumni status trigger automatically?
questions.answer: After 6 months of inactivity following completion of the Core.

questions.question: What is the maximum total freeze duration?
questions.answer: 6 months.

questions.question: A student scans a host that isn't listed in their security project subject. Is that allowed, and how serious is it?
questions.answer: Not allowed; acting against an unlisted target is a Tier 3 offense (referred to the Disciplinary Board under Internal Rules 7.3).

questions.question: How long are audience cookies stored?
questions.answer: At most 13 months (data from cookies, at most 25 months).

questions.question: How long is video-surveillance footage kept?
questions.answer: 21 days, unless preserved for an open incident.

questions.question: Does MCA guarantee the website is always available?
questions.answer: No; the site is provided without a guarantee of uninterrupted availability and may be suspended without notice.

questions.question: Who hosts the MCA websites?
questions.answer: Example Hosting SAS (fictional), Paris, France.

questions.question: What are the intranet password requirements?
questions.answer: At least 12 characters, including one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one digit, and different from the previous password.

questions.question: Can I let a friend use my intranet account?
questions.answer: No; the account is strictly personal and lending it is prohibited.

questions.question: May I commercially reuse data published on the MCA site?
questions.answer: Not without MCA's prior written consent.
